split.basis: original airport-local flight date (FL_DATE/flight_date_local); whole dates stay together; any derived original dates disclosed

selection_rule: Model: maximum validation average precision, then minimum Brier; threshold: maximum validation F1, ties use higher threshold
calibration_method: No post-hoc calibrator adopted (see calibration_experiment); held-out Brier and ten fixed reliability bins reported

calibration_experiment.method: Platt scaling on model log-odds (monotonic, so rankings and alerts are unchanged)
calibration_experiment.decision_rule: Fit on validation before 2024-09-01, adopt only if Brier on later validation falls by at least 1%; test outcomes are not used

weather_model.reason: Weather model fitted, but held-out weather coverage is incomplete; no performance claim for missing snapshots

data_audit.label_rule: cancelled == 0 and DEP_DELAY is known; severe iff DEP_DELAY > 45
data_audit.schedule_assumption: Reconstructed historical schedule, not an archived schedule snapshot; publication/revision timing is unverified.

limitations: Flight source coverage is retained; sample predictions are not complete airport demand.
Historical schedules are reconstructed; archived schedule publication/revision timing is not verified.
Training/validation labels are retrospective; historical BTS publication latency is not established.
Uncalibrated model probabilities: no post-hoc calibrator fitted; Brier score and held-out reliability bins quantify calibration.
No delay minutes, fuel savings, capacity or causal intervention benefits are inferred from delay probabilities.
Schedule-only probabilities do not model approaching weather and repeat across horizons; horizon labels identify prediction cutoffs, not measured lead-time sensitivity.

weather_risk.reason: Weather model fitted, but held-out weather coverage is incomplete; no performance claim for missing snapshots

impact.basis: Held-out test departures. At each airport/lead the baseline flags the same number of departures as the model, choosing the highest historical rates; tied rates are shared pro rata (expected value).
impact.status_quo: Training-only (2023) airport/local-hour severe-delay rate: the historical statistic a duty officer could consult without a model.
limitations: Measures alert quality only: recall and precision of severe-delay flags at equal alert workload.
No delay-minute, fuel, cost or savings benefit is claimed; no intervention was simulated or tested.
Sample coverage (about 0.8% of airport traffic); results describe this sample, not airport-wide operations.

storm_annotation.definition: Storm cohort: a NOAA Storm Events record for the airport's vicinity overlaps [target hour - 3h, target hour + 1h + 3h).
storm_annotation.use: Retrospective evaluation only; never a model feature or replay input.
storm_annotation.baseline_comparison: pr_auc and brier are threshold-free; baseline precision/recall flag the same number of departures as the model within each cohort.

failure_cases.explanation: Probability 0.035 stayed below threshold 0.146. BTS attributes the largest share (442 of 442 min) to carrier delay; NOAA logged a Winter Storm near the airport overlapping the target hour, while the forecast at the cutoff indicated precipitation. These are retrospective records consistent with the miss, not a proven cause.
failure_cases.remedy: Carrier and upstream-aircraft delays are not observable from weather or schedule features; catching them needs a cutoff-safe inbound-aircraft or carrier-status source. Human review remains required.

failure_cases.explanation: Highest-probability false alarm (0.612 against threshold 0.146); observed delay 21 min. The forecast at the cutoff indicated thunderstorms and precipitation, but no NOAA storm event was logged near the target hour. Risk scores are probabilities, so some flagged departures will operate normally.
failure_cases.remedy: Treat alerts as prompts for review, not actions; the validation-chosen threshold trades extra alerts for recall.

failure_cases.explanation: The weather snapshot for this cutoff was not accepted (status: partial), so the weather-enhanced prediction was withheld and the schedule-only model was used instead.
failure_cases.remedy: Label the row as schedule-only in the interface; it carries no lead-specific weather signal.

failure_case.explanation: Held-out misclassification; model uses limited schedule patterns and any verified weather available. No causal diagnosis is inferred.
